question.explanation: Drake's catalogue spans rap, R&B and pop, from early mixtape tracks to chart-topping singles. Collaborations, guest appearances and remixes count too.
question.criteria: A song on which Drake performs as a lead artist, collaborator, featured artist or group member; remixes also count.
